protocol_name: OPS-02 Dual-Tier Multiclass Perception Reporting Protocol

primary_metric_invariance_mandate.definition: Unweighted arithmetic macro-average of per-class IoU across phenomena classes 1..11 where GT_c > 0 (excluding Background class 0).
primary_metric_invariance_mandate.policy: IMMUTABLE AND FROZEN. This metric will NEVER be discarded, filtered, or redefined retroactively. It serves as the primary cross-replicate benchmark for historical comparability.

secondary_partitioned_reporting_specific.rationale: To prevent extreme minority classes (e.g. HM with 117 pixels on DEV) from completely obscuring model perception of major oceanographic structures, all future evaluation artifacts must provide a structured 3-tier report (GOV-RULE-089 / GOV-RULE-094).

tier_2_dominant_phenomena_subgroup.definition: Macro mean of IoU over phenomena with > 100,000 ground-truth pixels and robust parent cluster presence on DEV.

ultra_sparse_classes.definition: Phenomena with < 10k pixels on DEV or zero true positives
